I can join that conditional plan, provided my household can manage the donation. Growing up fishing here taught me that caring for the village means keeping both our neighbors and the lake healthy. Before taking an extra 10 tons beyond our usual sustainable total, let’s ask whether other donations could close that $10,000 gap for the clinic.

If we do need the 60-ton harvest, let’s write down everyone’s catch limits for both months and send donations directly to the clinic. Luke, will you also agree to the 6-ton limit next month? Emma, we haven’t heard from you—what could your household reasonably commit to?
